note: The repository's only structured EMC clinical-evidence store: cited cohorts, individual published cases, systemic-therapy evidence and contested-evidence questions, each resolving to a citation. PROMOTED out of the retired patient site on 2026-08-05 — it was never site tooling. Two research consumers read it and BOTH build the path segment-by-segment, so a text search for the old directory name finds neither: research/meta/meta-analysis.mjs (the manuscript's random-effects meta-analysis) and research/hypotheses/enumerate-drugs.mjs (the repurposing gap analysis, which uses it as the EXCLUSION list — without it, drugs already tried in EMC are reported as novel). Evidence contract: systems/POLICY-evidence.md, enforced by scripts/validate-registry.mjs, which is gate 2 of scripts/preflight.sh.
